narrationScript: Now it's your turn to get hands-on! We're going to create a 'Personalized Greeting Program'. First, save a new file named `greeting.c` with the basic 'Hello, World!' structure. Your task is to modify the `printf` statement inside the `main` function. Instead of 'Hello, World!', change it to display your name, or any custom message you like, such as 'Hello, Cohortia Learner!'. Once you've made your change, save the file. Then, open your terminal, compile your `greeting.c` file using the command `clang greeting.c -o greeting`, and finally, run your new program with `./greeting`. See your personalized message appear on screen!
